evidence_notes: Only public-source identities, aggregate counts, native receipt metadata and artifact hashes are committed here. Private signing keys and bulky native books are not included.

Old-engine outcomes preserve their previously observed identities and hashes. Original session-local books and other temporary artifacts are unavailable after container replacement; historical paths identify earlier evidence, not currently downloadable files.
Fresh repaired-engine results bind their actual f3f1d66 executables and unchanged source/driver/helper bytes before and after execution, even where checkout HEAD contains later changes.
Completed-attempt driver command counts can differ from transcript counts because resume preflight runs before the new attempt transcript is opened. Interrupted attempts are separately identified.
Each ADS negative control edits a separate copy and independently returns fa-verify exit 8. Identical refusal JSON is distinguished by the executed extract path and transcript line.

Repaired-engine workload passes and hosted test outcomes are separate: f3f1d66 built the executables but its workflow failed after four object-test passes and one failure; the genesis filter matched zero and the scheduled lifecycle command was not reached.
Controlled interruption is after a durable real native command. It does not assert recovery from an abrupt process kill or a torn storage transaction.

The source-bound university companion adds only --bind-source to preparation. Both the original unbound driver and explicit bound mode retain all original source, balance, dimension, export and tamper assertions.

Portable closure parsing is descriptive. Separate real fa-verify processes authenticate and recompute the retained historical report using the expected certificate, signed checkpoint, caller-trusted fixture public key and detached receipt.
Durations are observed execution times in this session, not comparative performance results or service-level claims.
No selected public-ledger fixture has a nonblank project code. Native runs exercise populated department, fund and product attribution; offline project tests remain separately scoped.
